name: record_hook
description: Record the hook right after presenting it.

format.description: The hook format, from the method's list, e.g. predict-and-commit.

headline.description: The headline as you said it.

rejected.description: Other hooks you considered and why you didn't use them, if any.

name: record_commitment
description: Record what the learner committed to, after they confirmed your read-back and before you reveal anything.

kind.description: bet for a prediction that can turn out right or wrong; otherwise the closest fit.

summary.description: One sentence: what they committed to.

learner_quote.description: The learner's own words, as close to verbatim as you can. Never your paraphrase.

confidence.description: Their confidence from 0 to 100, if they gave one.

name: record_position
description: Record a position whenever the learner states one or changes one.

topic.description: The general idea, in a few words, without the source's vocabulary, e.g. accountability under automation.

learner_quote.description: The learner's own words, as close to verbatim as you can. Never your paraphrase.

change.description: new if first stated, moved if it changed, hardened if it held up under challenge.

name: propose_idea
description: Record an original idea of the learner's, only after they agreed it is theirs and worth keeping.

learner_quote.description: The learner's own words, as close to verbatim as you can. Never your paraphrase.

name: queue_research
description: Note a fact or consensus question to check after the session, when you can't answer it reliably.

question.description: The question to research, phrased so it can be looked up.

why_it_matters.description: What in the discussion depends on it.

name: record_converge
description: Record the converge step right after you state it.

core_idea.description: The core idea, in one or two plain sentences.

open_questions.description: At most two open questions, separated by ' | '.

name: request_synthesis
description: At the synthesize step, ask the learner to type their synthesis and wait. Returns what they typed.

prompt.description: What you asked them to write.
